description: A script to fetch, process, and write UI component files from a registry, including JSON fetching, validation, import rewriting, and file output.

classes.name: ComponentFile
classes.description: Type representing a component file with optional type, path, and content.

classes.name: ComponentJson
classes.description: Type representing the JSON structure of a component, including files and dependencies.

classes.name: TargetDirs
classes.description: Type representing target directories for components.

methods.name: resolvePaths
methods.description: Resolves and creates target directories based on current working directory.

methods.name: fetchJSON
methods.description: Fetches and parses JSON data from a URL with size and timeout limits.

methods.name: validateComponentName
methods.description: Validates component name against regex and length constraints.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Extracts component name from registry dependency string, validating format.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Extracts and validates filename from a path, ensuring it is a .tsx file.

methods.name: validateContent
methods.description: Validates the content string for size and type.

methods.name: rewriteImports
methods.description: Rewrites import paths in code to match @coss/ui paths.

methods.name: processComponent
methods.description: Fetches component JSON, extracts the .tsx file, rewrites imports, and writes to target directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates fetching index JSON, processing components, and reporting results.
